target.title: fix(chutes): discover models when HTTP proxy is required
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users whose network requires a standard HTTP(S) proxy would wait for Chutes model discovery to time out and then see only the five bundled fallback models, even though Chutes' public live catalog was reachable through that proxy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fixed Chutes-owned catalog endpoint now uses OpenClaw's existing trusted-environment-proxy guarded-fetch preset while retaining the hostname allowlist, SSRF guard, timeout, cache, redirect handling, authentication fallback, and static fallback behavior. A focused regression test locks the transport policy and connection release behavior.

Related implementation pattern: #110924

## User Impact

Users behind an eligible HTTP(S) proxy can now see the current Chutes live model catalog. Users without a working proxy keep the existing safe timeout and static fallback behavior.

## Evidence

Live proof used only `pnpm openclaw` for OpenClaw runtime verification, with an isolated state directory and a test-only placeholder Chutes credential:

- **Before:** `pnpm openclaw models list --provider chutes --plain` timed out at the official catalog after 10,004 ms and returned 5 bundled models.
- **Third-party control:** Chutes' official public [`GET /v1/models`](https://llm.chutes.ai/v1/models) returned HTTP 200 with 13 models through the same standard proxy. Chutes' official [`llms.txt`](https://chutes.ai/llms.txt) describes this endpoint as the public, no-key-required source of truth.
- **After:** the same `pnpm openclaw models list --provider chutes --plain` command returned the same 13 live model IDs.
- **No-proxy control:** with all HTTP(S)/ALL proxy variables cleared, the command still timed out safely and returned the same 5 bundled fallback models.

Focused and extension verification:

- Regression test red before the production change because the guarded request did not select `trusted_env_proxy`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/chutes/models.proxy.test.ts`: 1/1 passed.
- `pnpm test:extension chutes`: 4 files, 26/26 tests passed.
- `codex review --base origin/main`: no findings; reviewer also ran 14 relevant tests successfully.
- Changed-file conflict, size, formatting, dependency, boundary, production/test type, lint, database-first, media, sidecar, and import-cycle gates passed. The aggregate changed-file command stopped only at the generated Plugin SDK API baseline mismatch, independently reproduced on a clean base checkout; this PR does not modify that baseline.
